control: frozen_learned_biped_gait+lidar_egomap+LEARNED_navgym_policy(onnx, PPO in the gym; lidar at 10 Hz packets here, every 0.04 s step in the gym; team_sensors speed brake still filters its commands); pose and goal are oracle; SCRIPTED command filter lpf-post-brake (tau 0.2 s)

judge.rule: TRUE position within goal_radius (ends the episode)

controller.rule: ESTIMATED position within goal_radius of the plan's last waypoint (the exact goal); commands zero

goal_check.note: with no pose error the judge fires on the post-step true pose one step before the controller would see it, so arrived_ever is expected false on a reached episode; the learned --policy has no arrival state

pose_error.applied_to: map + planner + controller (estimated pose); judge uses the true pose

cmd_filter.label: SCRIPTED deployment filter on the LEARNED actor's command (bhl_robust/eval/cmd_filter.py)
cmd_filter.form: x += alpha * (u - x), alpha = dt / max(tau, dt) (the NavGym lag)

policy_visitation.pose: the pose the observation is built at (oracle unless a pose error is injected)
